name: Restaurant Barn
old_description: From Commercial Kitchens to Home Kitchens, we have what you need, For Every Cook, For Every Kitchen
about:
Restaurant Barn operates from Ellsworth, Maine, as a locally owned restaurant supply company. The business serves commercial and home kitchens across Downeast Maine, though its founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks thousands of smallwares and large equipment items, including cooking equipment such as griddles, fryers, ovens, and ranges; commercial refrigeration and ice machines; sinks, dishwashing units, and bar supplies; and a broad range of tabletop and front-of-house items. It also offers kitchen planning and design services, financing assistance, free project estimates, and on-site consultation visits. The firm notes access to millions of additional products through global supply connections.

Customers include independent restaurants, bakeries, and food-service operations throughout the region. Testimonials cite Acadia Provisions in Ellsworth and a bakery in Bar Harbor as examples of businesses supported from start-up through ongoing supply needs. Home cooks are also welcome at the walk-in store.

Restaurant Barn emphasizes its local presence and community focus, positioning itself as a neighbor that provides personalized service, competitive pricing, and a willingness to visit project sites for better understanding. The company highlights its combination of in-stock inventory, quick-ship options, and the ability to source hard-to-find items as key differentiators.
